Only 1 out of 8 checkpoints passed (cylindrical body). The subject lacks key diagnostic features: uniform pinkish-brown color, blunt tail, and visible minute eyes. The presence of black bands and vibrant orange-red hue constitutes a fundamental species mismatch.

While the surface texture is glossy, it lacks the defined scale rows of a real macro photograph, appearing smeared. These are not minor aesthetic flaws but catastrophic structural failures.
